# teuteuteu.com

teuteuteu.com is a faithful web restoration of a minimalist Flash artifact documented online by 2005.
The original experience is one blue button, one absurd sound, and a precisely reconstructed sequence of 166 browser-window shakes.

Primary pages:
- https://www.teuteuteu.com/en
- https://www.teuteuteu.com/en/history
- https://www.teuteuteu.com/history-sources.json

Restoration: Mathieu Woroniecki
Source repository: https://github.com/mathieuworoniecki/teuteuteu.com
